# A release file exercising the quoting, escaping, and line-shape policy of
# `system.os_release`. The last line for a key wins, so `ID` is the later
# spelling; the indented comment is still a comment, and the line without `=`
# is ignored.
NAME="Fixture \"Quoted\" Linux"
PRETTY_NAME='Single quoted name'
VERSION="1.2\\3"
VERSION_ID=42
  # indented comment
NO_EQUALS_HERE
KEY_WITH_SPACE =spaced key
ID=fixture-os
ID=fixture-os-last
